entries.title: Learn-to-Play is a guided first-game slice
entries.summary: Use this 24-page guide for the core round, tactical/strategic action overview, status scoring, and first-game setup. It is not the complete Rules Reference; detailed exceptions, faction abilities, technologies, combat, and agendas remain outside local coverage.

source_locator.locator: Guide scope / First-Game Setup; Document type and section structure

entries.title: A round has strategy, action, status, and conditional agenda
entries.summary: Resolve Strategy, Action, and Status phases every round. Add the Agenda phase after the Custodians token is removed from Mecatol Rex; repeat until a player reaches the victory threshold or the objective deck cannot reveal further objectives.

entries.title: Strategy-card numbers govern repeated action turns
entries.summary: Players choose strategy cards in speaker order. During the Action phase, use the card numbers for initiative and keep cycling through turns; a player who passes is skipped thereafter and cannot pass before resolving their strategic action.

entries.title: A tactical action is a pipeline with optional branches
entries.summary: Resolve activation first, then optional movement, space combat if opposing ships remain, invasion/ground combat as applicable, and production if a space dock allows it. Not every tactical action uses every step.

entries.title: The active player gets primary; others may pay for secondary
entries.summary: When a strategy action is taken, resolve that strategy card’s primary ability. Other players then get the opportunity to resolve its secondary ability by paying the required command token; the active player cannot use its own secondary. Exhaust the card afterward.

entries.title: Objective timing is a scoring window, not a memory test
entries.summary: During Status, each player may score up to one public and one secret objective if its requirement is true at that moment. Action-phase objectives must be scored in their stated window; a public objective also requires control of all planets in the player’s home system.

source_locator.locator: Winning the Game; Status Phase; pp. 11–12

entries.title: Ten points ends the game immediately
entries.summary: The first player to reach 10 victory points wins. If the speaker must reveal an objective but none remains, the game ends and the highest score wins, with initiative order breaking a tie.

source_locator.locator: Winning the Game / Imperium Rex; p. 11
